name: APK SHA-256 Verifier
description: Check that an APK is the exact file the publisher listed: select a file and the page calculates its SHA-256 in your browser, reading it in 4 MB chunks, then compares it with the hash you paste in. Nothing is uploaded, no account is needed, and the page's Content Security Policy blocks network connections. A match shows the file is byte-identical to the published one; it does not show the app is safe.
